create_init_device_mesh: create a DeviceMesh with init_device_mesh using device_type, mesh_shape, and optional mesh_dim_names
build_device_mesh_context: build a DeviceMesh context manager to set and pop the current active mesh on the mesh stack
slice_device_mesh: slice a DeviceMesh into a child 1D mesh by specifying a mesh dimension name
get_device_mesh_groups: get ProcessGroups from a DeviceMesh for each mesh dimension or a specific dimension
get_device_mesh_local_rank: get the local rank within a specific mesh dimension of a DeviceMesh
